summary: Frontend-only regression of the new Trades page search/filter feature (WINNING/LOST status buttons + FROM/TO date range + CLEAR + SHOWING X/Y counter + differentiated empty state). All 9 test-case items from the review request PASSED against real historical data on the admin account (100 loaded trades, 76 winning, 17 lost, 4 failed, 2 currently open). Existing filters and refresh/sync/clear controls remain functional.

test_evidence.login: admin@trading.bot / admin123 login redirected to / then /trades loaded successfully
test_evidence.filter_winning: 76 rows returned; every sampled row has status CLOSED and pnl beginning with +$; visible-count = 'SHOWING 76 / 100'
test_evidence.filter_lost: 17 rows returned; every sampled row has status CLOSED and pnl beginning with -$; visible-count = 'SHOWING 17 / 100'
test_evidence.date_from_far_past: date-from=2020-01-01 → 100 rows still shown (nothing filtered out); visible-count shown ('SHOWING 100 / 100') because a client-side filter is active — matches implementation
test_evidence.date_to_yesterday: date-to=2026-07-01 (from empty) → 75 rows (<= yesterday); date-clear button appears
test_evidence.date_clear: Both inputs cleared, 100 rows return, visible-count hidden
test_evidence.combined_winning_plus_date: filter-winning + date-from=2020-01-01 → 76 rows, all still CLOSED with +$ pnl (intersection correct)
test_evidence.empty_state_with_filters: date-from=2030-01-01 (no matches) shows 'No trades match your filters\nTry clearing the date range or status filter.' (trades-empty testid)
test_evidence.existing_filters: filter-open=2 rows, filter-closed=100 rows, filter-pending=0 rows, filter-failed=4 rows — all render correctly
test_evidence.toolbar_buttons: REFRESH, SYNC WITH BROKER, CLEAR buttons all present and clickable (found by text; only CLEAR menu has a data-testid `clear-trades-menu`)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: filter=closed returns 100 rows equal to ALL, suggesting the backend /api/trades endpoint uses a default 100-row cap. Client-side date filtering therefore only refines the already-loaded window (a user setting date-from=2020 doesn't retrieve older trades beyond the 100 returned). Not part of this feature but worth flagging for a future enhancement to add server-side date range params or a 'load more'.

Minor: visible-count is shown as 'SHOWING 100 / 100' whenever a client-side filter is active even if nothing is filtered out (e.g. date-from=2020-01-01). This matches the code (`(dateFrom || dateTo || filter === 'winning' || filter === 'lost')`) and is arguably useful UX ('filter is active'), so keeping as-is.
Suggestion: consider adding data-testid to the REFRESH and SYNC WITH BROKER buttons (currently only findable by text) — minor testability improvement, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing production-like historical trades on admin account (165 total, 74.55% win rate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trades page filter feature is fully verified. Backend /api/trades appears to return only 100 trades (page cap) which is orthogonal to this feature. The `winning` and `lost` filters are client-side subsets of `closed` (backend receives status=closed), and the date range clamps opened_at in local timezone (start-of-day for FROM, end-of-day for TO). All new data-testids are wired correctly.
